sequences.story: Lucia helps her mother clean up their dilapidated property, survives an alligator attack in the pool, deals with an armed gang confrontation, and ultimately uses an excavator to demolish the gang's house in retaliation.
The narrative cuts between Jason and Lucia being questioned by police over stolen cars, escalating arguments, and a sudden violent ambush on the officers followed by escaping in a red vehicle.

The streamer navigates through swampy terrain on foot, deals with hostile NPCs and accidentally shoots them with a taser/gun, tries to get a stuck van out of the mud, opens the back doors to discover a tiger, shoots the tiger, and later gets into a UTV vehicle to drive down the highway.

The sequence follows Jason Duval from gearing up on the boat, diving into the ocean with NPCs, swimming through a coral trench while bantering, and exploring a shipwreck using a metal detector to hunt for hidden underwater treasure.
A chronological edit following Jason and Lucia from their police car encounter, argument over driving, subsequent crime spree, and getting back together in Vice City.

A complete sequence following characters at a nighttime street gathering in Vice City where they dance on vehicles, get into altercations, vandalize a car with spray paint and baseball bats, and finally escape through the city streets.

A sustained 6-star police chase beginning inside a military base, breaking out onto country roads, crossing bridges towards Vice City, battling N.O.O.S.E. units and helicopters, and eventually culminating in a 'wasted' screen after extensive damage.

A continuous sequence of open-world exploration and mission driving, starting with the auto-drive feature discovery, navigating through traffic and bridges, experiencing a severe collision, and arriving at the warehouse to talk to NPCs.
The player drives around Vice City at night, crashes into pedestrians and a tiki bar, interacts with NPCs, and escalates into a massive shootout with police ending in a 'wasted' screen.

The player explores the docks, interacts with wildlife, strolls through downtown Vice City at sunset, visits clothing stores, hangs out in a club lounge, and ends up in an escalating police chase after stealing a tour bus.

Jason stashes his money under the floorboards, explores his living quarters, takes a phone call from Brian about rent collection, rides his motorcycle through Key Lento, and drives down the highway while taking another phone call.

The player gets into a pickup truck, opens the map to plan a route, drives along the highway exploring the world, and witnesses a plane crash into the distance.
The sequence covers swamp boat travel, conversations about Donnie's fate, helicopter landings, and subsequent phone calls discussing shady business and retirement.
The player undertakes a seaplane drop mission in the Everglades-like delta, handles tricky water landings, inspects the map, and returns to the safehouse to deal with a probation officer encounter.

The sequence follows Lucia and Jason's confrontation with police, the ensuing chaotic escape in a red car, romantic dialogue inside the vehicle, and subsequent indoor domestic scenes.

A continuous gameplay sequence featuring map navigation, driving a customized Sultan sedan across rural roads and sugarcane fields in Leonard County, discovering the Farm Fix Meth Lab on the map, and arriving at a trailer park to interact with a Vapid Marshall monster truck.
